title: the Free Port Rising Revisited
premise: Sable Halloran, a whistle-blower living under four names in the smuggler's haven of Free Port, watches flight records for a vanished cargo plane erase themselves mid-flight and realizes his old handlers are still hunting the evidence he buried years ago. Forced out of hiding, he allies with a found family of dockworkers, a disgraced aviation investigator, and the assassin sent to silence him—who defects when she learns the flight carried her missing brother. Together they race to smuggle the truth past three governments, and at dawn, as the extraction plane lifts off, Sable chooses testimony over invisibility, broadcasting the manifest and finally sleeping through the night.
about_author: Coral Marchetti spent a decade working maritime logistics in free-trade zones before turning to fiction, and her thrillers are prized for their insider texture and moral ambiguity. She writes from a different port city every year, claiming that home is wherever the tide tables are accurate.

chapters.title: Four Names, No Sleep
chapters.summary: Sable Halloran, hiding in Free Port under his fourth identity, works night shifts auditing harbor manifests and wakes at 3 a.m. to check his escape routes. His POV establishes the cost of witness protection without protection: no friends deeper than a nod. Emotional beat: brittle, controlled loneliness.

chapters.title: The Flight That Wasn't
chapters.summary: A cargo plane vanishes from every tracking system while still airborne, and Sable recognizes the flight number from his whistle-blowing past. POV alternates Sable and investigator Nadia Reyes, who flags the same anomaly. Emotional beat: the sick vertigo of a buried past surfacing.

chapters.title: The Dockworkers' Oath
chapters.summary: Sable's carefully shallow ties to the dock crew—Marta, Teo, and old Ferro—deepen when they cover for him during a customs sweep, revealing they've always suspected he was running. POV Sable. Emotional beat: found family offered, and feared, because attachment is a liability.

chapters.title: The Woman with the Quiet Shoes
chapters.summary: Assassin Iva Kestrel arrives in Free Port under diplomatic cover, tasked with erasing the flight's last witness: Sable. Her POV reveals she's memorized his faces and his insomnia. She watches him for two days without striking. Emotional beat: professional patience curdling into doubt.

chapters.title: Buried in Salt
chapters.summary: Sable digs up the encrypted drive he buried years ago beneath a salt warehouse, but the retrieval is watched; he barely escapes, wounded, and Marta's crew hides him despite the danger. POV Sable. Emotional beat: the moment invisibility ends and trust begins.

chapters.title: Three Governments, One Lie
chapters.summary: Nadia decodes the manifest: the flight carried weapons sold with the complicity of officials in three nations, and Sable's old testimony was buried to protect them. POV alternates Nadia and a minister's fixer. Emotional beat: the scale of the cover-up, and the price of truth.

chapters.title: What Iva Was Promised
chapters.summary: Iva closes in on Sable but discovers the flight's cargo included a passenger manifest—and her brother, a conscripted pilot, was aboard and is alive, held as leverage. Her POV fractures her loyalty to her employer. Emotional beat: the assassin's first sleepless night.

chapters.title: The Long Night at Pier Nine
chapters.summary: Sable's safehouse is burned by the fixer's men; the dockworkers fight to get him to the harbor through a night of pursuit, and Ferro is gravely injured holding the line. POV Sable. Emotional beat: found family proven in blood; guilt and gratitude fused.

chapters.title: Extraction at Dawn
chapters.summary: At the airstrip, Iva turns her weapon on her own handlers to buy Sable time; he must choose between boarding the extraction plane to safety and staying to broadcast the manifest. He uploads it mid-runway, past three governments' jamming. Emotional beat: climax—courage replacing flight.

chapters.title: The First Full Night
chapters.summary: The broadcast detonates the cover-up; inquiries open, the dockworkers shelter Sable openly, and Iva leaves to find her brother with Nadia's help. Sable, under his real name at last, sleeps through the night. Emotional beat: resolution—truth chosen, family kept, rest earned.
